artworks.title: The Judge
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a room with decorated paneling in the background. The first figure on the left is partially turned away from the viewer, with their body seen from the back and their head turned slightly to the right. This person appears to be holding a scythe-like object. Next to them is a skeletal figure, also partially turned, with a bony hand resting on the shoulder of the central figure. The central figure is sitting on a block, their entire body visible. They are dressed in a voluminous robe with fur trim and a cap. This figure is gesturing with one hand towards the third figure. The third figure is standing to the right, fully visible, dressed in a tunic with a belt and a cap, holding a dish or hat in front of them. The background suggests an interior setting with a tiled or patterned floor, and there is an hourglass lying on its side on the ground in the foreground.

artworks.title: Der Bapst (The Pope)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a religious scene with figures in medieval attire. The central figure is wearing a papal hat. The artwork shows a detailed depiction of figures, including a seated individual in papal regalia having an interaction with a kneeling figure. Other figures surround them, some in elaborate robes, with skeletal figures and mythical creatures present. The setting includes ornate drapery and clerical insignia, adding to the religious and somewhat morbid ambiance. The intricate line work and medieval stylistic elements suggest a connection to this historical period's artistic expressions.

artworks.title: Skeletons Making Music
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger

artworks.title: Vßtribung Ade Eue (Expulsion of Adam and Eve)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring mythical elements. The image shows an angelic figure with wings in the sky atop a cloud holding a weapon. Below, two figures are running towards a skeletal figure with a scythe, standing among bare-branched trees. The style is similar to early Renaissance woodcuts or engravings, with bold lines and detailed designs reflecting movement and emotion in the composition.

artworks.title: Adam bawgt die erden (Adam Ploughing)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic scene with two figures engaged in labor. The image depicts a rugged outdoor setting where one figure is plowing the earth using a rudimentary tool. Beside the plowing figure, another figure with a skeletal appearance is depicted. A third figure sits in the background, appearing to hold an infant. The heavy use of lines and stark contrast creates a dramatic effect. The text above the scene reads "Adam bawgt die erden." The detailed engraving style emphasizes the textures of the ground and surrounding elements.

artworks.title: Die Hertzoginn (The Duchess)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows a woman on a large canopied bed, depicted in profile from the waist up. She has curly hair and wears elaborate clothing with intricate patterns. A skeletal figure leans towards her, and a small dog is near her feet. The background includes a patterned drape, a window with lattice work, and an ornate column supporting the bed canopy.

artworks.title: Erasmus of Rotterdam
artworks.artist: Veit Specklin after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person standing in a grand architectural frame topped by an ornate arch. The individual is holding a sculpted bust labeled “TERMINVS” with a wise expression. The person has distinctive facial features with a long nose and deep-set eyes, wearing a fur-lined hat and a fur-lined robe cinched at the waist. The background features detailed architectural elements including columns with sculpted figures and garlands, and cherubs on the arch, along with various intricate designs enhancing the classical and scholarly theme.

artworks.title: Saint Paul with Book and Sword
artworks.artist: Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing upright, slightly angled to the side. He has a long beard and shoulder-length hair, giving his face a solemn look. He wears a draped robe cinched at the waist with a belt, holding a book in his left hand and a staff in his right hand. He stands within an ornate architectural frame with classical elements like pillars and decorative floral motifs. The background is a plain, pale surface. An inscription "S.PAVLVS" can be seen at the base of the frame, identifying the figure.

artworks.title: Traffic in Indulgences
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical or religious scene. The image is composed of multiple sections, each depicting different figures and actions within a narrative. On the left, a divine figure with a halo is seen amidst clouds, gesturing towards a kneeling crowned figure identified as "K(David)." To the right, other figures stand in discussion, one of whom holds a staff directed towards banners reading "Manasses" and "Offen-synder." Further to the right, a collection of figures are engaged in an interior scene which includes a transaction and gesture of giving. The architecture suggests a grand hall with ornate detailing and columns. The setting is completed with additional figures and a figure seated on a throne-like structure. The lines and intricate details are consistent with traditional woodcut styles, giving a historical depth to the image.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.artist: German 15th Century
artworks.description: The image depicts two adults and a child. One adult, wearing a blue garment and brown overcoat, sits on a donkey while facing forward and holding the donkey's reins. The other adult, in a red robe with a blue lining, is seated behind them and holds a child on their lap. The child is wrapped in a white cloth with a halo. The adult on the donkey has a beard and wears a hood, while the other adult has a halo behind their head and hair covered by a veil. The adult on the donkey appears to be holding a stick or staff. The background features trees, a landscape, a path, and a blue sky.

artworks.title: Evening Wind
artworks.artist: Edward Hopper
artworks.description: This is an etching that depicts a woman kneeling on a bed with most of her body shown, viewed from the side. She is positioned with her shoulder facing us, her torso angled towards the bottom right corner and her head turned to the right, her face obscured. She is looking out of a large window, white curtains blowing towards her. She has pale skin, and her long, dark hair cascades over her shoulders and hides the upper part of her torso. The woman appears to be unclothed. The blankets of the bed have been pushed back, with two pillows near the bottom left corner. The room is lightly furnished, with a small table behind the pillows and a pitcher-like object on it. The wall behind the woman is black, while the space visible beyond the window is white.

artworks.title: Albrecht Durer
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Albrecht Dürer

artworks.title: Title Page to "Philosophia Universia"
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar after Abraham van Diepenbeeck
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial scene featuring a seated figure on a throne. The main focus of the drawing is the seated figure at the center who appears regal and is crowned, surrounded by an elaborate framework that includes lions at the foot of the throne and several other figures who seem to form a court or entourage. The scene is symmetrically composed with a columned architectural setting in the background, and the central figure is flanked by two classically styled statues or figures bearing spears. Overhead, putti decorate a crest or coat of arms above an inscribed banner dedicated to Maximilian. The overall style is highly detailed and ornate, reminiscent of Baroque engraving styles.

artworks.title: Jesus Confronting His Detractors
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a print of a group of robed people in a forested landscape. Four people on the left are standing, while a larger group on the right are sitting and holding tall staffs. On the right side, there is a lit candle on the top of a large staff that appears to be held by one of the seated people. On the left side, one of the people holds a large sword over their shoulder. Another person has their arm outstretched towards the group on the right. The background features a rocky outcrop, clustered trees, and a fence enclosing a small structure or gate. The print is monochromatic, with dark lines on tan paper.

artworks.title: Jesus on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image is a black and white woodcut illustration showing a scene with three figures at a wooden gate, with a wooded area and path in the background. There are additional figures in the distance engaged in various activities. A candle is prominently featured, and there is a small figure and a cross depicted in the clouds. The style features fine brushstrokes and intricate linework capturing detailed textures. The color palette is limited to black and white, highlighting the contours and forms. The horizon is not clearly defined, blending the foreground with the distant forest and cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Jesus Taken
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures entangled in a complex arrangement of poles and swords. The scene is set against a rocky landscape with detailed clouds and a tree on the right. The figures are densely packed, each donning robes and interacting dynamically with the objects around them. A prominent torch with a flame is at the top left. The rocky mountains in the background provide depth, while the tree adds to the setting. The line work and forms are rendered in a style reminiscent of woodcut or etching techniques, suggesting a historical or mythological narrative.

artworks.title: Jesus before Pilate
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of robed figures in front of a classical-style building with columns and an arched entrance. Surrounding architecture includes houses and a church. There are religious symbols such as crosses on tall staffs held by some figures. In the background, there is a bell, an incense container, and fluffy clouds in the sky. A haloed figure on a building emits rays. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of early Renaissance etchings.

artworks.title: Jesus again before Caiaphas
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of hooded figures in a medieval interior gathered around a figure seated on a throne. The composition features a series of arches in the background, including a round window and a columned inset. On the right, a highly adorned figure sits in a throne elevated by steps while various cloaked figures approach carrying staffs and other symbolic items. The drawing's details include flowing robes, ornate headgear, distinct architectural setting, and a gargoyle-like figure above. Intricate hatchings and fine lines offer depth and shadow, enhancing the scene's dramatic and formal atmosphere.

artworks.title: Jesus before Caiaphas
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger

artworks.title: Jesus before Annas
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several monks and religious figures in an interior setting. The individuals are gathered around a central figure seated on a throne-like chair elevated on a platform with steps leading up to it. The background features arches and pillars, with candles on stands positioned on either side of the central figure. The figures are dressed in clergy robes, and two of them hold staffs. The composition suggests a ceremonial or religious meeting, with a focus on the central seated figure. The drawing is rendered in fine lines creating depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Washing of Hands
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with religious and historical elements. Classical architecture is depicted in the background, with figures in robes engaging in different activities in the foreground. Seated figures are shown reading or writing a document, while other figures stand nearby. One figure holds a cross, and others are in acts of supplication or carrying baskets. The drawing is detailed and intricate, suggesting a historical narrative, possibly related to religious or judicial themes from the past.

artworks.title: The Scourging
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows figures in an architectural setting. The scene features figures within a space defined by columns and arches, engaged in actions. The central figure is tied to a column, surrounded by others holding various objects. The background includes architectural elements like columns and arches, creating a confined spatial environment. Small objects are scattered on the floor. The drawing is detailed, capturing textures and tones. The artwork conveys drama and complexity.

artworks.title: The Mocking
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image depicts several cloaked and robed figures in an architectural setting. The figures are shown interacting with each other, some holding items like staffs, a container, and a chained object. The architecture features large arches, recessed panels, and a central ornamental shell. Textured dome-like structures are depicted above the figures, adding depth to the space. The drawing utilizes shading and line work to create depth and texture.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar, after a follower of Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a lower and upper section. In the lower part, there are figures, some walking or standing. One character in flowing robes gestures or speaks to others, possibly wearing a headpiece like a papal tiara. Beside them, a woman in a long dress and wide-brimmed hat stands. The individuals hold tall objects, including staffs with crosses or orbs. In the upper section, two figures stand on a balcony within an arched architectural structure. The central figure wears a crown and has a beard, suggesting authority or royalty. The second figure leans slightly forward. The background features architectural elements like a stone archway and textured walls, hinting at a significant building.
